title: feat(studio): Data rail search + inline new-object (draft into the package)
body:
Closes the two remaining v1 rail gaps from the builder design (§4).

## What

- **Search** filter on the objects rail (label/name).
- Inline **新建对象** creator: 显示名 + auto-derived snake_case **标识符** (hand-editable — CJK labels can't derive one). Creates the object as a **draft in the current package** (the classic editor's runtime-create path), seeded with one text field, and lands in **表单 · 布局** (the metadata-level designer).
- **Draft-only objects get honest placeholders** instead of broken surfaces: the Records grid explains data arrives after publish (no SQL fired at a table that doesn't exist yet), 预览 explains there's no published definition yet. Both turn live automatically after the package publish (publishNonce).

## Verified in-browser (fresh backend, worktree vite)

- Search: "inv" → rail filters to Invoice / Invoice Line ✓
- Creating into the **read-only code package** (com.example.showcase) surfaces the ADR-0070 `writable_package_required` error clearly ✓ (correct gate, correct message)
- Creating **报修工单/repair_ticket** into a writable base (`POST /packages` → com.example.workbench): lands in 布局 with the seeded field, header shows 未发布草稿, top bar **变更 · 1** ✓
- Draft-only: Records → "未发布的新对象" placeholder ✓ · 预览 → "尚无已发布定义" ✓
- Top-bar **发布** → scoped `_drafts` = 0, **`GET /data/repair_ticket` = 200** (physical table created), grid placeholder gone + Create live, 预览 renders the published form ✓

`type-check`: 0 errors.
